description:
BEAUTIFUL DETACHED FAMILY HOME WITH LARGE GARDEN

Savills are delighted to present No. 5 Upper Clevedon, a superb four-bedroom detached family home ideally positioned in a quiet cul-de-sac, with no property directly opposite, creating a lovely sense of privacy. Presented in very good order throughout, this attractive property offers generous accommodation, excellent privacy, a wonderful rear garden and exciting potential for further extension, subject to planning permission.

A welcoming entrance porch opens into the spacious hallway. To the left is a large and inviting living room featuring timber flooring, a lovely fireplace, built-in shelving and an attractive bay window. Opposite is a versatile study, which could also be used as a fifth bedroom or additional reception room if required. To the rear, a beautifully presented lounge features a fireplace and patio doors opening directly onto the garden.

The impressive kitchen is a real highlight, with extensive fitted units, a comprehensive range of appliances and a large central island providing an excellent space for family living and entertaining. A separate utility room houses the washing machine and dryer and provides convenient side access. A guest WC completes the ground floor.

Upstairs, the spacious and unusually wide landing leads to four well-proportioned bedrooms, with two positioned to the front and two to the rear. The principal bedroom benefits from built-in wardrobes and a modern ensuite shower room.

Outside, the front of the property provides comfortable off-street parking for two cars and enjoys an attractive outlook over a green area. The large, rear garden is a fantastic feature, enjoying excellent sunshine and incorporating a paved patio, shed and generous side access. There is also plenty of scope to extend the existing accommodation, subject to planning permission.

The property further benefits from gas-fired central heating and a PhoneWatch alarm system.

The location is exceptionally convenient, with a 220 bus stop approximately 60 metres away and Carrigaline town centre just 1km from the property. A choice of schools, shops, sporting facilities and local amenities are all within easy reach, while the nearby coastline provides easy access to Crosshaven, Fountainstown, Myrtleville and Kinsale.

Cork Airport is approximately 10.5km away, Cork City Centre 13km, CUH 17km and UCC 19km. Planned road infrastructure between Carrigaline and Cork City is set to further enhance connectivity and commuting times.

No. 5 Upper Clevedon is a wonderful family home offering space, privacy, convenience and excellent future potential, making it an ideal choice for first-time buyers, growing families or those looking to trade up.
